tickets.title: Address cash reserve shortfall and remaining apartment lease
tickets.text: Address the household cash reserve shortfall relative to Mira Willowdoodle’s six-month preference and the financial impact of Mira’s remaining apartment lease through May 31, 2024. Include the $24,000 in wedding costs and combined monthly spending of about $9,600.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-18 is to address the cash reserve and remaining lease impact.

tickets.title: Obtain certified marriage certificate for account and insurance records
tickets.text: Obtain a certified or scanned marriage certificate to provide to custodians and insurance carriers for account registration, beneficiary updates, and name-related record changes.
tickets.evidence: The custodian and insurance carriers may require a certified or scanned marriage certificate for account registration, beneficiary, and name-related records, and Mossy Meteor Advisory did not have a copy in the client file;

tickets.title: Provide taxable account registration options (individual vs. joint)
tickets.text: Provide a plain-language comparison for keeping Mira’s Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account individually titled versus opening a new joint account for future household savings.
tickets.evidence: Mira asked for paperwork and a plain-language comparison for keeping her Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account individually titled versus opening a new joint account for future household savings; the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-01 is to provide the taxable account registration options.

tickets.title: Set up online access for spouse without trading authority

tickets.evidence: She also asked whether Arlen could receive view-only access to the household dashboard without giving him trading authority over her individual IRA and taxable accounts; the agreed follow-up by 2024-02-29 is to address online access for a spouse and household view.

tickets.title: Resolve beneficiary record inconsistencies across accounts
tickets.text: Resolve the inconsistent beneficiary records across Mira’s IRA accounts (still naming Tobin Willowdoodle and Iris Willowdoodle) and Arlen’s employer-plan screen (no primary beneficiary displayed), and update records to reflect post-marriage status.
tickets.evidence: The beneficiary information visible during the call showed Mira’s IRA records still naming Tobin Willowdoodle and Iris Willowdoodle, while Arlen’s employer-plan screen did not display a primary beneficiary, creating inconsistent post-marriage records across accounts; follow-up is needed by 2024-03-0

tickets.title: Address custodian beneficiary update error
tickets.text: Address the Velvet Acorn Custody website error that prevented Mira from adding Arlen as a contingent beneficiary, including the failed session that did not produce a confirmation number.
tickets.evidence: Mira reported that Velvet Acorn Custody’s website returned an error when she tried to add Arlen as a contingent beneficiary, and the failed session did not produce a confirmation number; the agreed follow-up by 2024-02-27 is to address the custodian beneficiary update error.

tickets.title: Review employer benefit elections for combined household
tickets.text: Review employer benefit elections for Mira’s Clockwork Clover Robotics newlywed enrollment window and Arlen’s Paper Otter Preparatory benefit-change process, covering medical, life, and disability coverage choices for the combined household.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s Clockwork Clover Robotics newlywed enrollment window and Arlen’s Paper Otter Preparatory benefit-change process affect medical, life, and disability coverage choices for the combined household; the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-05 is to review employer benefit elections.

tickets.title: Align life and disability coverage across policies
tickets.text: Align the beneficiary records and replacement-income assumptions across Mira’s individual term policy, group life coverage, Arlen’s term policy, and Arlen’s employer coverage for the new household.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s individual term policy, Mira’s group life coverage, Arlen’s term policy, and Arlen’s employer coverage had different beneficiary records and replacement-income assumptions for the new household; follow-up is needed by 2024-03-14 on life and disability coverage alignment.

tickets.title: Collect estate document copies and amendment pages
tickets.text: Collect copies of the signed wills and financial power of attorney documents, including any amendment pages, for both Mira and Arlen, as the advisory file does not have copies.
tickets.evidence: Mira signed a will and financial power of attorney in 2018 before the marriage. Arlen signed a will in 2016 after Pippa was born. Mira and Arlen described older wills and powers of attorney, but Mossy Meteor Advisory did not have copies of the signed documents or any amendment pages in its planning

tickets.title: Review mortgage and property records
tickets.text: Obtain and review the current mortgage statement, deed vesting page, and homeowner policy declarations for Arlen’s Lakewood townhouse, including the $378,000 balance at 4.125% with Silver Marmot Mortgage.
tickets.evidence: Arlen had the mortgage balance and rate available during the call, but the current mortgage statement, deed vesting page, and homeowner policy declarations were not available. Follow-up is needed by 2024-03-15 for the mortgage and property record review based on those missing property records.

tickets.title: Prepare joint tax withholding and estimated-tax projection
tickets.text: Prepare a coordinated 2024 withholding and estimated-tax projection to share with tax preparer Celia Fablethimble, reflecting the marriage combining two salaries, bonuses, investment income, and Mira’s $42,000 capital loss carryforward from 2022.
tickets.evidence: Mira and Arlen asked for a coordinated 2024 withholding and estimated-tax projection to share with Celia because the marriage combines two salaries, bonuses, investment income, and Mira’s capital loss carryforward; the agreed follow-up by 2024-04-05 is to prepare the joint tax withholding projection
